name: Culver's
disclaimer_extra: Culver's does not publish nutrition itself — it hands the job to Nutritionix and links that calculator from its own menu, so these figures come from the export Culver's points its customers at. The parts add up exactly: a lightly toasted buttered bun (220), one ground beef patty (170) and a slice of American cheese (70) make the 460 Culver's publishes for a single ButterBurger Cheese.
blurb: Build a Culver's ButterBurger from the bun up — patties, cheese and toppings — or start from a named sandwich and change it.

categories.name: Patty or Filet
categories.note: A ButterBurger is one patty per name — Single, Double, Triple. Use the quantity control to stack them.
